crossRefs.note: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;
Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
“Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to…
Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying…

translations.web: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
translations.bsb: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve
translations.asv: and shalt not turn aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
